name: 9ja-vote
description: 9ja Vote (Project Nigeria Vote) - election information, transparency and controlled demonstration platform. NOT an official INEC system.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @9ja-vote/api -w @9ja-vote/public-web -w @9ja-vote/admin -w @9ja-vote/broadcast
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
